extracted.intended_audience: organizations/applicants using Grants.gov (especially teams with one or two registered users)
extracted.subtask_description: Step-by-step guidance for organizations (especially with one or two registered users) to create a Grants.gov workspace, distribute PDF forms to unregistered collaborators, validate and submit the application, and track/download the submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum Required User for Basic Approach
rubrics_metrics.description: Make sure at least one person at your organization is registered and has one of the core AOR roles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Without a Grants.gov account, a team member will not be able to access the workspace and fill out application webforms. In this scenario, at least one registered user should have one of the core AOR roles so that a workspace can be created and an application submitted. If you want additional individuals to help complete webforms, then all these contributors should register a Grants.gov account.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design an internal application workflow
rubrics_metrics.description: Design an internal application workflow that ensures each PDF form is downloaded from the workspace and shared with unregistered team members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the interactive workflow graphic to understand, at a high level, the process you will need to follow to complete your application. Not all steps in the workflow will apply to teams of one or two applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create the workspace (Apply) and identify Workspace Owner
rubrics_metrics.description: Log in and create your workspace by clicking on the Apply button on the View Grant Opportunity page of a posted grant announcement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In the basic scenario, the Standard/Expanded AOR clicks the Apply button and creates the workspace, becoming the Workspace Owner.

rubrics_metrics.name: Download individual PDF forms and distribute to unregistered team members
rubrics_metrics.description: Download individual PDF forms and distribute them to unregistered team members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registered users who have been added as Participants may complete webforms within the workspace. Unregistered applicants on your team will be restricted to completing only the individual PDF forms that are shared with them. Without a Grants.gov account, they will not be able to access the online workspace and its webforms. Consider reusing forms from previous workspaces.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for Errors, upload completed forms, and submit
rubrics_metrics.description: Upload all completed forms to the workspace and submit the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be sure to click the Check for Errors button on the PDF form before uploading it back to the workspace. Workspace performs some error checks on form fields automatically. Other checks are run by clicking the Check Application button within the workspace. At any point after all forms are in the 'Passed' status, the Standard/Expanded AOR may click the Sign and Submit button.

rubrics_metrics.name: Track submission and download submitted application for records
rubrics_metrics.description: Track your application and download the submitted application for your offline record-keeping.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After submitting, applicants can track the application using the tracking number received from Grants.gov. The Standard/Expanded AOR should download a copy of the submitted application for offline record-keeping and verify the contents of the submission zip file. We recommend tracking and downloading the application via the Details tab of the workspace.

rubrics_metrics.name: Process Checklist
rubrics_metrics.description: Checklist of required actions to complete the basic workspace approach.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Checklist items: Do you or another team member have either the Standard or Expanded AOR role (required to submit a completed application)? Have you instructed unregistered team members how to complete PDF forms assigned to them? Have you created your workspace? Have you downloaded and distributed the PDF versions of all required forms? Have you uploaded all required forms? Have you ensured that all required forms are in the 'Passed' status? Have you submitted the application? Have you checked on the status of your submitted application? Have you downloaded a copy and verified the contents of the submitted application?
